goal: Implement the native app shell, Material 3 theme foundation, top-level navigation host, and Android back behavior model.
non_goals: Do not implement Room schema or repositories.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
acceptance_criteria: Main destinations exist as native routes: Sessions, Chat, Context hub, Global graph, Sources, Settings, Import/export, and About/diagnostics.
Material 3 theme foundation is centralized rather than embedded entirely in MainActivity.
Top-level app shell exposes title/status actions appropriate for internal preview.
Android back first closes modal/sheet state.
Android back exits Context hub to Chat.
Android back exits Chat to Sessions.
Android back on Sessions allows app-level exit.
Empty destinations are clearly marked as internal preview placeholders.
Existing mobile/ PWA package config and signing assets are unchanged.
verification_expectations: Run app module unit tests for navigation/back state.
Run native Gradle assembleDebug, test, and lint.
If ADB device is available, install and launch preview and capture evidence.
notes: This is still a scaffold task. Placeholder screens are acceptable, but the navigation/back model must be real and testable.
